newsitem.title: USA: Sport Supply to issue stock to Emerson Radio.
newsitem.headline: Sport Supply to issue stock to Emerson Radio.

text.p: Sport Supply Group Inc said on Friday that is has agreed to issue 1.6 million new shares and warrants to purchase up to one million more shares to Emerson Radio Corp for $12 million in cash and $2 million in trade finance credit.
Sport Supply said it will no longer be in default under agreements with its senior lender because the $12 million will be used to repay outstanding bank debt.
The trade finance credit will be for the purchase of goods sourced in the Far East through a foreign subsidiary of Emreson.
The warrants are five-year warrants to purchase up to one million shares of newly issued common stock at $7.50 per sahre.
Sport Supply stock closed Friday at 5-7/8.
Sport Supply said that when the transactions are closed it will have "significant" availability under its senior credit facility for general corporate purposes.

The company said that its Audit Committee determined that the delay necessary in securing shareholder approval prior to the issuance of the securities would seriously jeapordize its financial viability.
It said that based on that determination, the New York Stock Exchange granted the company an exception to its policy that would normally require shareholder approval for the transaction.
